mapper.select: SELECT id, name, color, type, usage_count, status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted, tenant_id FROM ydsz_wiki_tag WHERE name = #{name} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, name, color, type, usage_count, status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted, tenant_id FROM ydsz_wiki_tag WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY usage_count DESC, name ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.color, t.type, t.usage_count, t.status, t.created_by, t.created_at, t.updated_by, t.updated_at, t.revision, t.is_deleted, t.tenant_id FROM ydsz_wiki_tag t INNER JOIN ydsz_wiki_file_tag ft ON t.id = ft.tag_id WHERE ft.file_node_id = #{fileNodeId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND ft.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.name ASC
SELECT id, file_node_id, tag_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted, tenant_id FROM ydsz_wiki_file_tag WHERE file_node_id = #{fileNodeId} AND is_deleted = 0
